title: MLG Airhorn
blurb: The MLG airhorn — the layered, spammed airhorn barrage of the montage-parody golden age. One airhorn is hype; forty airhorns stacked over a 360-noscope with Doritos raining is culture. This is the sound of 2014 YouTube in its purest form, preserved for modern deployment. Use it whenever anything even slightly impressive happens. BRRRRT.
origin: The signature airhorn spam of MLG montage-parody culture.
